summary: The PR addresses the issue by modifying the check for monotonic coordinates to only apply to dimensions that were actually concatenated. The added test cases help verify the fix.

issues.description: The addition of new test files (`reproduce_error.py` and `test_edge_cases.py`) is not part of the source change as per instructions, but the test cases themselves are valuable. However, they should ideally be included in the existing test suite structure.
The modified code lacks a comment explaining why the check is limited to concatenated dimensions, which could improve maintainability.
